findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-contracts.ts:396-416 — MEDIUM: validatePromptEnvelope treats every optional field as merely nonblank, so digest-bearing fields such as toolPolicyDigest and systemInstructionDigest accept arbitrary strings. Runtime reproduction with toolPolicyDigest="not-a-digest" prints MALFORMED_OPTIONAL_DIGEST_ACCEPTED. This contradicts CHK-001 adversarial schema intent requiring malformed digest values to fail closed and leaves the foundational Story-2 envelope schema permissive before it becomes gate-bound. Split optional digest fields from optional text/reference fields and validate each digest with requireDigest; add mutation probes for all optional digest-bearing fields.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 973f9ce95a: PromptEnvelope optional material/storyFiles/policy/tool/system digest fields now use requireDigest; focused smoke mutates every optional digest and requires explicit rejection.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-contracts.ts:161-198 — MEDIUM: canonicalJsonStringify enumerates only Object.keys and therefore silently drops symbol-keyed own properties instead of rejecting non-CanonicalJson input. Runtime reproduction canonicalJsonStringify({a:1,[Symbol("hidden")]:2}) returns {"a":1}, allowing two structurally different inputs to collapse to the same canonical bytes/digest. This directly violates CHK-001 canonical-fail-closed intent that unsupported values must not disappear or produce an admissible digest. Reject own symbol keys (and cover the mutation in the focused smoke) before canonicalizing object entries.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 973f9ce95a: canonical serializer rejects own symbol keys before enumeration; focused smoke proves symbol-keyed input cannot collapse to canonical bytes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-role-contract-registry.ts:249 The supposedly frozen lifecycle registry does not fail closed on replacement drift. validatePromptRoleContracts checks membership, the 12/3/1 partition, retired-channel/default status, and compatibility status, but never verifies the accepted exact mappings (test-intent/test-case-reviewer -> verification-intent and implementation-reviewer -> quality+behavior guidance). Reproducer against the built module: clone PROMPT_ROLE_CONTRACTS, change test-intent.replacementAgentType to lattice-review-quality, then call validatePromptRoleContracts(...); it returns successfully (ACCEPTED_INVALID_REPLACEMENT). This directly violates CHK-004's requirement that replacement metadata violating frozen policy be rejected and would let a semantically different compatibility migration target retain an admissible registry shape.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 973f9ce95a: RoleContract validation compares exact replacementAgentType and migrationHint against frozen policies; replacement and guidance mutations now reject.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-contracts.ts:127 canonicalJsonStringify enumerates objects with Object.keys(), so unsupported own symbol keys and non-enumerable own fields silently disappear instead of failing closed. A plain object with a=1, one with an own Symbol key whose value is undefined, and one with a non-enumerable own hidden=undefined all serialize to the same {a:1} canonical JSON and produce the same domain-separated digest. That contradicts CHK-001's explicit invariant that unsupported/undefined values cannot disappear or collapse to an admissible digest, and it creates a content-address collision class before PromptEnvelope uses this primitive. Reject non-string/non-enumerable own keys (or otherwise mechanically constrain the accepted object domain) and add mutation probes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 973f9ce95a: canonical serializer rejects symbol-keyed, non-enumerable, and accessor own fields; focused probes cover all three disappearance classes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-contract-measurement-smoke.ts:100-205 and 327-335 — HIGH: the focused smoke never deletes a required field from RuntimeContract, RoleContract, PromptMeasurementRecord, or PromptEnvelope. It tests unknown/invalid values, but the must adversarial intent and recorded evidence explicitly claim missing required fields fail closed. A regression that stops requiring one field could therefore pass this suite. Add representative required-key deletion probes for all four schemas (ideally table-driven) and rerun the bound evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 973f9ce95a: table-driven deletion probes remove every required key from RuntimeContract, RoleContract, PromptMeasurementRecord, and PromptEnvelope and require fail-closed rejection.

findings.desc: scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:2291-2409 — MEDIUM: --probe-baseline-drift mutates structuredClone(current) and compares two in-memory snapshots; it never changes one actual assembled Prompt/template, observes the normal verifier fail on bytes/hash, restores the source, and observes PASS. CHK-004 adversarial:2 requires that exact integration/restore path, while its evidence note accurately says only synthetic mutations. Add a non-destructive temp-worktree or injectable collector integration probe that exercises the real collection boundary and proves repository restoration.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 973f9ce95a: verifier copies the real registry to an OS temp directory, collects pristine source/assembled output, mutates a copied prompt, proves normal registry/output bytes-hash comparisons fail, restores in finally, proves pass, and removes temp state; protected repository paths remain unchanged.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-contracts.ts:178-185 — HIGH: the round-2 canonicalization fix validates hidden/accessor/symbol own fields only for plain objects; arrays return before that validation and still silently discard extra own state. Runtime repros show an array [1] with Symbol("hidden")=2, hidden=2, or an enumerable accessor derived all serialize as [1] (ACCEPTED), so distinct unsupported inputs still collapse to identical canonical bytes/digests. This is the same fail-closed root class as resolved F-002/F-004 and still violates CHK-001 canonical-fail-closed. Validate array own keys/descriptors too, allowing only dense numeric indices plus the intrinsic length data property, and add symbol/string/accessor array probes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 29789e7eeb: arrays accept only intrinsic length and exact dense enumerable data indices; symbol, extra string, non-enumerable and accessor own state rejects with focused probes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-contracts.ts:178 F-004 is only partially fixed: the new Reflect.ownKeys fail-closed checks run only in the plain-object branch, while arrays return at line 184 after validating numeric indices only. Arrays carrying an own Symbol key, an extra enumerable string field, or a non-enumerable/accessor field still serialize and hash byte-identically to the plain array, so unsupported values continue to disappear. Reproducer: compare canonicalJsonStringify([1]) with arrays mutated by arr[Symbol(...)]=undefined, arr.hidden=undefined, or defineProperty(arr,'hidden',{value:undefined,enumerable:false}); all return [1] with the same digest. The CHK-001 invariant covers nested object/array values and requires all otherwise non-canonical input to fail closed; validate array own keys/descriptors as well and add corresponding probes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 29789e7eeb by the same complete array own-key/descriptor validation; extra enumerable/non-enumerable/malformed keys and symbol keys cannot disappear into an admissible digest.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-contracts.ts:178 F-008 still does not close the full array runtime domain: Array.isArray accepts array subclasses and arrays with custom prototypes, but the implementation does not require the ordinary Array prototype and invokes candidate.map through the untrusted prototype. A subclass can override map() so canonicalJsonStringify of a one-element array returns the invalid/non-canonical string [MALICIOUS]; a custom prototype preserving Array.prototype.map plus hidden inherited state serializes and hashes identically to [1]. This breaks determinism/fail-closed canonicalization even though own-key probes now pass. Require the supported array prototype/domain and invoke the intrinsic Array.prototype.map (or iterate indices without prototype dispatch), with subclass/custom-prototype mutation probes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 181771de4b: canonical arrays require Object.getPrototypeOf(candidate)===Array.prototype and serialize by explicit index loop over validated own data descriptors; subclass/custom prototypes reject before any candidate method invocation.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-contract-measurement-smoke.ts:89-109 — HIGH: the expanded array mutation matrix still omits Array subclasses/custom prototypes and prototype-dispatched map behavior. Independent repro against current dist shows an Array subclass overriding map serializes as invalid [MALICIOUS], while an Array with a custom prototype carrying hidden inherited state serializes as [1]. Because packages/main/src/core/prompt-contracts.ts invokes candidate.map and does not restrict the array prototype, CHK-001 canonical-fail-closed remains uncovered. Add subclass, overridden-map, and custom-prototype probes and require ordinary Array.prototype (or intrinsic index iteration) before refreshing evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 181771de4b: smoke proves malicious subclass map and candidate-owned map are never invoked, custom inherited state rejects, and ordinary dense arrays serialize deterministically.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-contracts.ts:165-211 — HIGH: canonicalJsonStringify still accepts Proxy-wrapped arrays. Array.isArray(proxy) is true and the proxy can report Array.prototype, while hasOwnProperty/Reflect.ownKeys/Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor invoke attacker-controlled traps. A minimal proxy whose getOwnPropertyDescriptor returns an incrementing value for index 0 serializes the unchanged same proxy as [3] on the first call and [6] on the second. Thus the canonical/digest entry point is neither deterministic nor side-effect-free for an unsupported runtime structure, violating CHK-001 deterministic and canonical-fail-closed intents. Reject Proxy inputs before array/object traversal (for example Node util.types.isProxy) and add array plus plain-object proxy probes proving no traps are consumed into admissible bytes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 04e9e4385d: util.types.isProxy rejects every Proxy before Array.isArray, prototype, ownKeys or descriptor traversal; stateful array Proxy cannot produce bytes or trigger traps.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-contract-measurement-smoke.ts:61-134 — HIGH: canonical fail-closed/determinism coverage omits Proxy-wrapped arrays and objects. findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 04e9e4385d: smoke covers instrumented plain-object and stateful array Proxies with zero traps invoked, revoked Proxy rejection, and unchanged normal plain inputs.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-contract-measurement-smoke.ts:335-456 — HIGH: coverage proves construction-time role-policy mutations reject, but never tests post-export mutation of PROMPT_ROLE_CONTRACTS or report-time revalidation. findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:125 and :372 Extension filtering uses only the diff header's b/new path (DiffFileSources.file = header[2]), so renaming a supported source file to an unsupported extension hides a real deletion. Reproducer: a diff from a/src/removed.ts to b/docs/removed.md deleting `export function realDeletion()` and adding Markdown prose yields analyzeDeletedSymbols(...) = {symbols:[], diagnostics:[]}. The same bypass applies to JS/Python renamed to JSON/Markdown/text. This violates the round-8 requirement that bounded filtering not hide real TS/JS/Python deletions. Track oldPath and newPath separately, parse each side according to its own supported extension/script kind, and add supported-to-unsupported rename probes; malformed supported old/new sides must remain fail closed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 3fd29d4993: diff reconstruction now retains independent oldPath/newPath including /dev/null and parses each side only according to its own supported language family. Supported-to-unsupported renames remain deletions, additions do not fabricate deletions, path-bound supported renames preserve explicit identity, and malformed supported sides still fail closed.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/concept-gate-scope-smoke.ts:122-141 — HIGH: mixed-artifact coverage omits supported-source to unsupported-artifact renames. Independent repro renaming src/removed.ts to docs/removed.md while deleting export function realDeletion returns symbols=[] and diagnostics=[] because analyzeDeletedSymbols classifies both sides by the new path. This leaves the round-8 real TS/JS/Python deletion guarantee bypassable. Add TS/JS/Python supported→unsupported and unsupported→supported rename probes, plus malformed supported old/new side cases; bind each side to its own path/parser so real deletions remain visible and malformed source remains fail closed.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 3fd29d4993 with adversarial coverage for TS/JS/Python supported-to-unsupported renames, unsupported-to-supported additions, supported path renames, /dev/null addition/deletion, malformed supported old/new sides, and ignored non-source artifacts. Concept smoke and real story concept validation pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:141 The old/new path fix still treats Git copy patches as if the source path were removed. diffFileSources ignores `copy from` / `copy to` metadata, and declaration identity is path-bound, so a modified copy from src/original.ts to src/copied.ts with the same still-existing function produces symbols=[stillExists], diagnostics=[] even though no concept was deleted. A 100%-copy patch with context behaves the same. On repositories/configurations that enable copy detection this can create spurious residuals and block REVIEW despite the original declaration remaining. Distinguish copy metadata from rename metadata (or model the copy old side as a survivor), and add pure/modified copy probes while retaining current rename and /dev/null fail-closed behavior.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5ccc18596f: Git copy metadata is parsed explicitly and copy old sides never enter removed declarations, including modified copies; rename path-bound deletion behavior remains unchanged. Git diff/header/rename/copy paths now share fail-closed C-quoted path decoding.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:154-186 — MEDIUM: diff path parsing handles only unquoted `diff --git a/... b/...` and unquoted `--- a/...`/`+++ b/...` headers. Git default core.quotePath emits C-quoted headers for non-ASCII/control-character paths (for example `"a/src/\344\270\255.ts"`). Those header lines fall into the synthetic __fragment__.ts source; the path octal escapes are parsed as TypeScript and produce bogus `Octal escape sequences are not allowed` diagnostics. Repro with an otherwise valid deletion of `unicodePathDeletion` returns the symbol plus three diagnostics, so the concept gate falsely blocks legitimate source changes under Unicode filenames. Parse/decode Git C-quoted path tokens for diff/side headers (while preserving /dev/null), and add default-quoted Unicode plus tab/quote path probes proving correct side identity and zero diagnostics.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5ccc18596f with probes for pure/modified/quoted-metadata copies, rename semantics, C-quoted UTF-8 octal and tab/newline/quote/backslash paths, space paths, malformed quoted paths, and actual declaration deletion through quoted paths. Build, concept smoke, real concept validation, prompt/proof/process checks pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:250 Path parsing is still not fail-closed on internally inconsistent diff metadata. The parser silently overwrites `diff --git` paths with `---`/`+++` or copy/rename metadata without cross-checking them, and treats any single `copy from` or `copy to` line as a complete copy. Two reproducers both return symbols=[], diagnostics=[] while deleting a supported TypeScript declaration: (1) header a/src/deleted.ts b/src/deleted.ts followed by `--- a/docs/not-source.md`, which changes the old side to an ignored extension; (2) header old.ts/new.ts with only `copy from old.ts`, which sets copy=true and suppresses the old declaration side. This violates malformed-input fail-closed and permits a truncated/inconsistent patch to hide true deletion. Track header, side-marker, and copy/rename paths separately; require consistent pairs and matching operation metadata before committing a section, otherwise emit a focused diagnostic. Add mismatch and incomplete copy/rename self-check probes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in d636c516d4: decoded diff --git paths remain authoritative; ---/+++ are validated instead of silently overwriting, with bounded /dev/null addition/deletion semantics. Rename/copy metadata is pair-complete, unique, mutually exclusive, header-matched, and invalid copy metadata cannot suppress old declarations.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/concept-gate-scope-smoke.ts:206-294 — HIGH: copy/rename/quoted-path coverage omits internally inconsistent or incomplete diff metadata. Independent repros show (1) diff --git old path src/deleted.ts overwritten by --- a/docs/not-source.md and (2) a lone copy from without copy to both hide a supported TypeScript deletion with symbols=[] and diagnostics=[]. This leaves malformed-input fail-closed bypassable. Add header-vs-side-marker mismatch, incomplete copy from/to, incomplete rename from/to, and operation-path mismatch probes; parser must validate complete consistent metadata before suppressing an old side or changing source classification.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in d636c516d4 with fail-closed probes for side-header mismatch, lone/duplicate copy and rename sides, copy+rename conflict, metadata/header mismatch, /dev/null conflicts, plus valid no-hunk pure copy/rename and normal hunk behavior. Full concept/prompt/proof/process checks pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:350 Mode metadata is checked for pair/count/path consistency but not for legal ordering. A malformed patch can append a fully matching `copy from`/`copy to` pair after the `---/+++`, hunk header, and deletion/addition lines; flush then considers it validCopy and suppresses the already reconstructed old side. Reproducer deleting `hiddenLateCopy()` from source.ts, adding replacement(), then appending matching copy metadata returns symbols=[], diagnostics=[]. The equivalent late rename still reports the deletion, demonstrating a copy-specific bypass. Enforce the Git section state machine: copy/rename metadata must appear before patch side headers/hunks/content, side headers before hunks, and no mode/path metadata after content; late metadata must emit a focused diagnostic and must never set validCopy. Add late-copy/late-rename/late-side-header probes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 786cf10c8c: explicit per-file diff state enforces metadata, side-header, hunk, and content ordering; invalid late/conflicting metadata never enables copy suppression. Addition/deletion /dev/null direction, header identity, and forbidden content are fail-closed. Focused ordering/direction, valid no-hunk copy/rename, multi-source, and binary behavior probes pass with full validation.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:254-312,359-394 — HIGH: the metadata state machine still accepts contradictory /dev/null sections that can suppress deletions. Repros all return symbols=[] and diagnostics=[]: (1) authoritative header `a/src/victim.ts -> b/src/addition.ts` with `--- /dev/null`; (2) an addition (`--- /dev/null`, `+++ b/src/victim.ts`) containing a removed `-export function suppressed...` line; and (3) a deletion (`+++ /dev/null`) containing added lines. Because oldSourcePath=/dev/null skips old declaration analysis, malformed input can silently reclassify a deletion as an addition. Enforce /dev/null header consistency (the authoritative old/new paths must denote the same surviving file for add/delete) and hunk directionality (null old side cannot have removed/context old content; null new side cannot have added/context new content), with focused suppression probes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 786cf10c8c: explicit per-file diff state enforces metadata, side-header, hunk, and content ordering; invalid late/conflicting metadata never enables copy suppression. Addition/deletion /dev/null direction, header identity, and forbidden content are fail-closed. Focused ordering/direction, valid no-hunk copy/rename, multi-source, and binary behavior probes pass with full validation.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/concept-gate-scope-smoke.ts:243-372 — HIGH: malformed metadata coverage validates pair/count/path consistency but omits section ordering and /dev/null hunk directionality. Independent repros show (1) matching copy metadata appended after hunk content suppresses a real deletion, (2) --- /dev/null with a removed declaration, and (3) +++ /dev/null with an added declaration all return symbols=[] and diagnostics=[]. Add late copy/rename/side-header probes plus null-old removed/context and null-new added/context probes; enforce metadata→side headers→hunks/content ordering and reject impossible /dev/null content before validCopy or source classification can suppress declarations.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 786cf10c8c: explicit per-file diff state enforces metadata, side-header, hunk, and content ordering; invalid late/conflicting metadata never enables copy suppression. Addition/deletion /dev/null direction, header identity, and forbidden content are fail-closed. Focused ordering/direction, valid no-hunk copy/rename, multi-source, and binary behavior probes pass with full validation.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:218-235 — MEDIUM: unquoted `diff --git` parsing splits on the first ` b/`, but Git paths may legally contain a space followed by a `b/` directory segment. For `diff --git a/src/a b/file.ts b/src/a b/file.ts` with matching `--- a/src/a b/file.ts`, `+++ /dev/null`, and a valid deletion hunk, parseDiffGitPaths derives authoritative paths `src/a` and `file.ts b/src/a b/file.ts`; analysis returns symbols=[] plus header-identity/mismatch diagnostics instead of the deleted symbol. Thus a legitimate space path is falsely blocked after the stricter state-machine repair. Make unquoted pair parsing unambiguous against both side tokens (or require/consume authoritative side headers before validating), and add same-path plus rename/copy probes where old/new paths contain ` b/`.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 3d9cabef8d: unquoted diff headers enumerate every b/ delimiter candidate and resolve only through side-header, rename/copy, null-identity, or exact-symmetry corroboration; unresolved/ambiguous headers fail closed. Binary markers now fail closed for any supported TS/JS/Python authoritative or metadata endpoint, while unsupported binaries remain ignored. Full path-ambiguity and binary add/replace/delete/rename/copy probes pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:458 Binary sections are accepted diagnostic-free for every path, including supported declaration-bearing extensions. A `.ts`, `.js`, or `.py` file replaced by binary content—or a binary deletion reported as `Binary files a/src/deleted.ts and /dev/null differ`—returns symbols=[], diagnostics=[], so all prior source declarations disappear without concept review. The current smoke only proves `.bin` remains ignored and misses this supported-source boundary. For any binary section whose authoritative old or new path has a supported TS/JS/Python extension, fail closed with a focused diagnostic (especially replacement/deletion and `/dev/null` direction); retain diagnostic-free behavior only for unsupported binary assets. Add supported-source binary replace/delete/add/rename/copy probes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 3d9cabef8d: unquoted diff headers enumerate every b/ delimiter candidate and resolve only through side-header, rename/copy, null-identity, or exact-symmetry corroboration; unresolved/ambiguous headers fail closed. Full path-ambiguity and binary add/replace/delete/rename/copy probes pass.

findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 3d9cabef8d: unquoted diff headers enumerate every b/ delimiter candidate and resolve only through side-header, rename/copy, null-identity, or exact-symmetry corroboration; unresolved/ambiguous headers fail closed. findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:251 gates legacy fragment fallback only on lines starting with the exact string `diff --git `. Header-like but malformed inputs therefore bypass strict parsing: `diff --git` with no trailing space, `diff --git\t...`, and a fragment containing only `---`/`+++`/`@@` headers all return a deleted symbol with diagnostics=[] in independent probes. This violates the intended boundary that fallback is available only for truly headerless +/- fragments and lets malformed structured diff input be accepted instead of failing closed. Detect any structured header token before fallback (at minimum /^diff --git(?:\s|$)/ plus side/hunk headers as appropriate), emit a focused diagnostic, and add negative probes for bare, tab-separated, and orphan side/hunk headers while retaining the valid single-line headerless fragment case.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in f959a28ba9: legacy __fragment__.ts fallback is enabled only when the entire input contains no structured diff control token. Bare/tab diff headers, orphan side/hunk/rename/copy/binary/index/mode/similarity tokens disable fallback and receive fail-closed diagnostics; pure headerless +/-/context and empty input remain compatible. Exact gitroot and concept smoke regressions plus full checks pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/concept-gate-scope-smoke.ts:79-105 — HIGH: headerless fallback coverage rejects one malformed quoted `diff --git ` header but omits other structured-header forms. Independent repros show bare `diff --git`, tab-separated `diff --git\t...`, and orphan `---`/`+++`/`@@` headers all fall back to __fragment__.ts, report deleted symbols, and emit diagnostics=[]. Add bare/tab/whitespace diff-token and orphan side/hunk header probes; fallback must be limited to truly headerless +/- fragments, while any malformed structured diff marker fails closed with a focused diagnostic.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in f959a28ba9: legacy __fragment__.ts fallback is enabled only when the entire input contains no structured diff control token. Bare/tab diff headers, orphan side/hunk/rename/copy/binary/index/mode/similarity tokens disable fallback and receive fail-closed diagnostics; pure headerless +/-/context and empty input remain compatible. findings.desc: .lattice/story/actives/B-360e/checklist.json CHK-003:adversarial:no-writes — recorded PASS command is not independently reproducible and therefore does not prove the read-only invariant. Exact clean-state replay of `git status --porcelain > before; ...; git status --porcelain > after; cmp before after` returns rc=1: shell redirection creates `before` before the first status (first snapshot contains `?? before`), then creates `after` before the second status (second snapshot additionally contains `?? after`).
